behavior: One transient owner binds clip, project/edit/media generations, track, exact selected local audio URL, duration and media-clock floor.
Begin permits independent invalid old title/timing/paste drafts and admits only current cue text plus genuine loaded native media; no automatic seek/play.
Starts and ends use represented native currentTime without rounding. Pause and temporary buffering preserve pending/completed marks; seek/source/rate/loop/backward/hidden retire.
Focused Mark Enter/Space keydown marks once; repeats/modifiers are ignored, keyup never marks, and blur/retirement transfers held keys into a blocked-until-keyup latch.
Natural end never creates an automatic boundary; only a last open line exposes the explicit clip-end action.
Every completed line/text/gap is displayed literally in a bounded scroll review; no partial Apply.
Apply validates cues/connected limits, computes semantic no-op and captures exact current raw baseline, then synchronously checks actual media ownership before history/model changes.
Changed Apply uses existing one-edit LyricHistory/changed path and replaces only cues; title and pasted words/dirty marker survive. No-op preserves exact nodes/raw spelling/video/redo.
Save and lyric/video export are unavailable while timing capture/review is active; Save remains an explicit revision-checked request after Apply.
Existing SRT, waveform, project, archive and media job intent paths retire timing; retirement itself does not rebuild cues, save, or record history.
native: No browser/service/build run by this producer. Independent owner uses actual local WAV playback with trusted actions and read-only currentTime observations.
claims: Manual line timing, not lyric recognition, word alignment, measured physical latency or click precision beyond observed browser media timing.
naturalEndedBoundary: Only ended && currentTime exactly equals admitted native audio.duration may exceed project duration within the existing 1/44100-second duration tolerance. The clock floor retains that actual observation; explicit final closure supplies exact project duration. Normal Mark remains gated by !ended and the pure strict project range, and complete Apply admits the same ended endpoint.
reviewCorrection: Network stalled is not playback waiting: only actual waiting latches the playback gate, while real readyState independently disables unavailable media and playing releases the waiting latch. Source-only independent finding; no fabricated media event or clock runtime claimed.
